title: Data Quality Challenges in Multimodal Tourism Recommender Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.13972v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern recommender systems increasingly consider diverse data modalities to enhance model performance. However, the quality of the underlying multimodal data (e.g. data from social media platforms) has received limited attention so far. Focusing on tourism recommendation, we examine real-world challenges encountered when using datasets from Yelp and Instagram. Issues include noise from fake reviews, hallucinated content from LLMs, modality contradictions, and demographic bias. We outline future directions such as quality-aware fusion, structured and controlled LLM-based content generation to reduce hallucinations, and user group differentiation to improve the robustness and reliability of multimodal recommendation systems.

translated_title: 多模态旅游推荐系统中的数据质量挑战
translated_abstract: 现代推荐系统日益考虑多样化的数据模态以提升模型性能。然而，底层多模态数据（例如来自社交媒体平台的数据）的质量迄今为止受到的关注有限。本文聚焦于旅游推荐领域，检验了在使用Yelp和Instagram数据集时遇到的现实世界挑战。这些问题包括虚假评论带来的噪声、大语言模型（LLM）产生的幻觉内容、模态间的矛盾以及人口统计学偏差。我们概述了未来的研究方向，例如质量感知融合、结构化和受控的基于LLM的内容生成以减少幻觉，以及用户群体差异化，以提高多模态推荐系统的鲁棒性和可靠性。
tldr: 该论文聚焦旅游推荐场景，揭示了使用Yelp和Instagram等真实多模态数据时面临的虚假评论噪声、LLM幻觉内容、模态矛盾和人口偏差等数据质量挑战，并提出质量感知融合、受控LLM内容生成和用户群体差异化等未来改进方向。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies real-world data quality challenges—fake review noise, LLM hallucinations, modality contradictions, and demographic bias—when using Yelp and Instagram datasets for tourism recommendation, and proposes future directions including quality-aware fusion, controlled LLM-based content generation, and user group differentiation.
